questions.question: What does rust around wheel nuts mean?

options.text: The tires need to be replaced.

questions.explanation: Rust around wheel nuts means they might be loose. Check how tight the nuts are if you see rust.

questions.question: In bad weather, many drivers:

options.text: Drive to the sides of trucks.

questions.explanation: In bad weather, many drivers follow large trucks too closely. This is especially common when they cannot see well.

questions.question: Traction is important for:
questions.explanation: Without good traction, you cannot brake or steer safely. Keep your tires in good condition before driving.

questions.question: When pulling a trailer, the air supply control lever should be in the ____ position.
questions.explanation: Some older vehicles use levers instead of knobs for tractor protection controls. The air supply control should be in the "normal" position when pulling a trailer.

questions.question: When should you slow down for a curve?
questions.explanation: Slow to a safe speed before entering a curve. Slowing down in the curve can cause you to skid.

questions.question: How often should you use your mirrors?

options.text: Only when someone helps you watch blind spots.

questions.explanation: Check your mirrors on both sides of your vehicle frequently while driving.

questions.question: The more alcohol in your body:

options.text: The faster your liver will process it.
The less it will affect you.
The longer it will take your body to remove it.

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer it will take your body to remove it.
questions.explanation: Your body removes alcohol at a fixed rate. More alcohol means it takes longer to leave your system.

questions.question: Before a trip, you should check the coupling to make sure:

options.text: There is no gap between the upper and lower fifth wheel.
There is no mud on the fifth wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is no gap between the upper and lower fifth wheel.
questions.explanation: Check that there is no gap between the upper and lower fifth wheel. The locking jaws should be tightly closed around the kingpin.

questions.question: When parking, you should not use the parking brake if:

options.text: There is snow on the ground.

questions.explanation: Do not use the parking brake if your brakes are hot after going down a steep hill. Let them cool first to avoid damage.

questions.question: What do air brakes use to work?
questions.explanation: Large vehicles often use air brakes. Air brake systems use compressed air to operate.

questions.question: When using a fire extinguisher, what should you do?

options.text: Get as close to the fire as possible.
Stand as far away from the fire as possible.
Aim the extinguisher at the top of the fire.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stand as far away from the fire as possible.
questions.explanation: Stand as far away from the fire as possible. Aim at the base of the fire, not the flames. If you are unsure which extinguisher to use, especially for hazardous materials, wait for firefighters to arrive.

questions.question: The air compressor is connected to the:
questions.explanation: The air compressor connects to the engine through gears or a belt. It may be cooled by air or by the engine's cooling system.

questions.question: What kind of brakes do most newer heavy-duty trucks use?
questions.explanation: Most newer heavy-duty trucks use dual air brake systems. This system has two separate air brake systems that share one set of brake controls.

questions.question: A pre-trip inspection should include:
questions.explanation: During a pre-trip inspection of the engine, check the engine oil level, the radiator coolant level, and the condition of the hoses.

questions.question: When leaving your vehicle unattended:

options.text: Use the parking brake only if the vehicle is parked on a slope.
Do not use the parking brake because it can damage the tires.

questions.explanation: Always use the parking brake when parking. However, do not use it if your brakes are very hot or if they are wet and the temperature is below freezing.

questions.question: When mirrors are properly adjusted:

options.text: No part of the vehicle should be visible in the mirrors.
A part of the vehicle should be visible in the mirrors.
More than half of each mirror should show the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: A part of the vehicle should be visible in the mirrors.
questions.explanation: A properly adjusted mirror shows some part of the vehicle. This helps you judge the distance of other objects from your vehicle.

questions.question: To avoid a hazard, you:

options.text: Should always come to a complete stop.
May need to swerve your vehicle out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: May need to swerve your vehicle out of the way.
questions.explanation: Stopping is not always the best way to avoid a hazard. If you do not have enough space to stop, swerving may be your safest option.

questions.question: To prevent a vehicle from rolling backward when starting to move forward from a stop, you should:
questions.explanation: To prevent a vehicle with a manual transmission from rolling backward, partly engage the clutch before lifting your foot from the brake pedal.

questions.question: Air brakes use ____ to function.
questions.explanation: Air brakes work by using compressed air.

questions.question: To make it easier to leave a parked position, you should park:

options.text: In a way that allows you to back up when exiting.
In a way that allows you to pull forward when exiting.
Only on the side of roadways, not in parking lots.

questions.correctAnswerText: In a way that allows you to pull forward when exiting.
questions.explanation: Backing is dangerous and should be avoided. Park in a space that allows you to pull forward when leaving.
